keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

planetgta6.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list, Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: This pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. No online play is needed: PowerPyx counts 0 online trophies, and no DLC is required. Follow the roadmap in order (story first, then the 100% checklist, then stranger strands and cleanup) and this is the last trophy you earn.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1; it unlocks as soon as the mission ends. PowerPyx lists every story trophy this way: finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play through Chapter 1 to its end; PowerPyx notes it unlocks once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Just keep playing the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 2; PowerPyx notes it unlocks once you start the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. No side task is needed for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Keep following the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Nothing else is required.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss — this is the gold trophy for finishing the story's final mission. PowerPyx ties it to the same finale mission, Starting From Zero. There is no difficulty setting to worry about, since the game has none, and no mission medal to chase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end and it unlocks during the mission. PowerPyx lists it as a straight story unlock.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end and it unlocks during the mission. No preparation or side content is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end and it unlocks during the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end and it unlocks during the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end and it unlocks during the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and impossible to miss. Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end and it unlocks during the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, says PowerPyx, and the long middle of the platinum. After the story ends, a 35-task checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and anything you already did during the story already counts toward it. Nothing on it is missable and everything can be finished in free-roam. It is far kinder than it sounds: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% true completion, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required. The big asks are 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions, and 15 of the 18 meditation spots; robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need completing in full. Work it in Step 2 of the roadmap, about 100 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute — mix them freely and pick the easiest. Under the bridges is the quickest kind to grind. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the 9 activity types PowerPyx lists: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Progress, then Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most arrive on their own while you play the story and work the other trophies, so PowerPyx says not to worry about this one at all.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. PowerPyx links the full location list, and notes the golds are not too hard — and the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this is not a detour. Work through the ranges after the story, when your shooting and focus are levelled up.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations — 42 drone races in total, says PowerPyx. The races are also needed in full for the 100% checklist. Learn each course once, then race it clean; you only need one win per location, not every race at it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Any 20 count, so skip the ones you hate and repeat the courses you like — but each win must be a different race, not the same course twice. Races also feed the activity count for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal first: he shows up in the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui. Some time after that, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline from there. PowerPyx says the challenge unlocks through that questline, so if no text has arrived yet, keep playing the story and check your phone.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick the game you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked on its own in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All five of her quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. Finish the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline gets marked on its own in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls you; he is then marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — follow the purple chest icons, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring the finds back to his shop. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so the trophy cannot be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline gets marked on its own after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All five of his quests stay available after the story: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Finish the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — but not every side quest counts. PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape search), Kyle (McKittrick Farm and his chemicals), Yago (street racing and mentoring), and Pilot Pete (plane recovery and package deliveries). All of them are still findable in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked on its own after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and watch for the popup when you scan or enter a car he wants. Deliver each one to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); a clean delivery pays more. High-end sports cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked on its own after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and the quest Take Out Kitty Litter asks you to destroy them. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, which shuts the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY — read this first. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The trap is in Chapter 1, at Jason's house: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. That first meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1. PowerPyx is clear that the author did it and then earned the trophy, but it is still UNCONFIRMED whether that first meditation is actually required — do it anyway, to be safe. The last spot needs both characters together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist. Sources: PowerPyx and GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and gets marked on its own after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck (15 decks, all needed for 100%). One detail is still unconfirmed, says PowerPyx: exactly which animal pops this trophy, so finish the whole questline rather than stopping at one hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations to work through — you do not need every set in the game, just three finished ones. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: follow the location guide, pick up every card in a set, and the trophy pops when the third set completes.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots: hold Up and then R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags as you pass them. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more besides, so there are well over 100 to choose from — any 100 count. Scan everything you walk past from the start and this lands on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way there — PowerPyx says you will unlock it automatically while working the checklist. Track them under Progress, then Challenges, and when you are near the end, pick the easiest and quickest ones you have left; 10 more challenges exist than the checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First unlock free-roam with your partner: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you can call them by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level — causing carnage gets you there fast — and escape: a quick sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works, and PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the big bank vaults always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Then hit 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time: keep the flashing wanted level, do not lose it between shops. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus healing items. The pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover any 100 vehicles. The fastest way, says PowerPyx, is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you never need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The game has 557 vehicles at launch and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops early on the way there. Check your totals under Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots light up, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one use, so set it up first — eat or drink to buff focus, take Adrenaline to stretch the slow time, and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies. It gets easier as your focus levels up to 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it), and may well pop on its own late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the ones on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the boarding bridge, and climb the stairs by the bridge into the plane (or walk in through the terminal on foot). Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards onto the strip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive in through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter a store through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door (kicking trips the alarm). Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. PowerPyx names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot for it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (it gets marked on its own from story progress): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hand off a bag with Right. After that, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 each, once you have robbed 2 Payday Loans for him first) and follow the purple van icons to more banks. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. Any 5 vaults pop this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 8 large bank jobs — up to $205,000 per bank, the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops on its own in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — the same mission that opens bank vault robberies — because tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way, says PowerPyx, is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the entire map is visible. You will clear most of it naturally by driving the story and side quests across the state; save the last corners for a single sweep flight.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them (many are also marked from story progress), and the 100% checklist wants all 39 — so this pops on the way there. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. All this guide can honestly say is the official description: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Do not trust any method you read that cites no source; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. It only works with this blue Banshee, not any other car: PowerPyx calls it an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked on its own. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can come back for what is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at a fitness club — filter the map by Activities to find them — and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself tracks your count out of 500, so click the trophy to see where you stand. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. PowerPyx lists the profiles from cleanest to worst — Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable, which is permanent — and says this comes naturally while you work the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, repeat profile-changing actions until the counter hits 500. GTABase reports the same 500-action method.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. All this guide can honestly say is the official description: second time's the charm. Do not trust any method you read that cites no source; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. All this guide can honestly say is the official description: what the hell just happened? Do not trust any method you read that cites no source; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. All this guide can honestly say is the official description: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Do not trust any method you read that cites no source; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally while you do robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — it is cumulative, not one purchase. The fastest way, says PowerPyx, is guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive things in the shops. You will spend much of it naturally on weapons, upgrades and gear while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total (the 4 story garages do not count). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone: buy each garage through the app. Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles so they can be delivered to you anywhere. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in his garage — he only takes vehicles without trackers at first, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need garage space first (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots; register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
